thread:
nina: Quick flag — mosaic14b-int4 canary showing intermittent OOMs on mixed-turn chats with long priming (~>1000 tokens). Low traffic but noisy failure pattern. Repro log below.

oshin: Can you paste the log and current serving config?

nina: Sure. Snippet: 

```
# /var/log/inference/mosaic-canary.log
[2025-11-08T21:05:02Z] ERROR oom: failed alloc 67108864 bytes at gpu_pool.cc:139
[2025-11-08T21:05:02Z] INFO seq_len=1320 prefetch_slots=30 kv_cache=1.1GB post_frag=0.69
[2025-11-08T21:05:02Z] INFO serving-config: max_new_tokens=320 batch_size=6 prefetch=aggressive quant=gptq-v4 alloc_align=256
```

ben: Sounds like the allocator align change + aggressive prefetch repeating pattern. Any kernel changes?

riley: No kernel flips recently; mostly quant table + alloc_align tweak. I ran a local sweep (20k mixed reqs):
- canary: OOM_rate 9.2% when seq>1100, p95 460ms
- config1: max_new_tokens=128, batch_size=3, prefetch=moderate => OOM_rate 1.0%, p95 510ms
- config2: config1 + compactor.interval=75s + kv_trim_threshold=0.57 + soft_reserve=1.0GB => OOM_rate 0.15%, p95 530ms

oshin: Okay. Proposal: per-model safety profile instead of global revert. Suggested mosaic profile:
- model.profile.max_new_tokens = "128"
- model.profile.max_batch_size = "3"
- model.profile.prefetch = "moderate"
- runtime.kv_trim_threshold = "0.57"
- compactor.interval = "75s"
- runtime.soft_reserve = "1.0GB"
- runtime.alloc_align = "512"  # model override to reduce fragmentation
- fallback.variant = "mosaic14b-int8" when session_len > 800 or oom_rate > 1.5%
- pod.kernel_fallback = "attn-stable" if alloc_failures > 4% in 10m

nina: Also add soft-evict: evict oldest KV segments when free_mem < 1.0GB. That helped in my reproducer.

ben: Good. Add alerts: canary oom_rate > 2% for 10m => auto-rollback; memfrag > 0.66 for 5m => pager. And block promotion if long-context ROUGE-L drops >0.8%.

ops-bot: @nina config-patch "mosaic14b: safe-profile-v1" applied to canary pool (8% traffic) by ops-bot at 3723456820 :wrench:

eval-bot: Eval queued: convos-bench (50% short / 50% long), deterministic seeds, compare int4 safe-profile-v1 vs int8 & fp16. ETA ~90m.

riley: I'll add memfrag waterfall panels and per-kernel alloc failure counters to the perf dashboard. Also instrument Optimize to run the long-context quality probe daily.

nina: (later) Eval summary: int4 + safe-profile-v1: OOM_rate 0.3% (down from 9.2%), ROUGE-L delta vs fp16 = -0.2%, avg latency +6%. int8 fallback: OOM_rate 0%, ROUGE-L delta = -1.0%, latency +3%. Recommendation: keep int4 with safe-profile-v1 and auto-fallback to int8 on session_len>800 or oom alert.

ben: Agreed. Add short runbook: how to force int8 for a tenant, how to revert profile, and how to interpret memfrag waterfall.

nina: PR: https://git.redwood/inference/infra/patches/4591 1 - includes model profile, compactor tweak, soft-evict, dashboard panels, and runbook. Merging after 1h if no objections.

ben: Merge on green. :rocket:
